Scores measure how closely the two photos match.

COLOUR STRENGTH

Colour strength is similar to the reference.

VALUE RANGE

Value range is noticeably narrower than the reference across the whole picture.

The Value score compares where light and dark shapes fall. Value range compares how widely the tones vary, so a close match can still have a narrower range.

Room light, reflections and your phone’s camera affect colour readings.

Edges · Match

Shows how closely your painted edges match the reference.

Left: the reference's contours over your painting, coloured by how close your edges are. Right: the same contours on the reference, for orientation.

NearFurther awayNot checked

Green lines are nearest your edges; orange and red lines are further away. Faint lines aren’t included in the edge comparison. Edges may be unpainted, softly blended or difficult to detect.
